research_findings: Discovered a missing rate-limit implementation for the waitlist action in `src/app/actions/waitlist.ts`, marked with a TODO comment.
The codebase did not have `@upstash/ratelimit` or `@upstash/redis` installed, which are standard for rate limiting in Next.js apps.
new_features_added: IP-based sliding window rate limiting (5 requests per 60 seconds) for waitlist signups.
next_steps_for_next_run: Investigate and implement rate limiting for other public-facing APIs (e.g., AI chat endpoints) to further secure the application.
